headword: {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}
gloss: deathly pale; white as a sheet

definitions.gloss: deathly pale; white as a sheet
definitions.explanation: A state where one's face has lost all color, typically from shock, fear, illness, or extreme emotion.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}になった。
{知|し}らせを{聞|き}いて{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}だった。
examples.english: She was white as a sheet after hearing the news.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}の{結果|けっか}を{見|み}て、{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}になる{学生|がくせい}もいた。
examples.english: Some students turned pale upon seeing their exam results.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{現場|げんば}を{目撃|もくげき}した{人々|ひとびと}は、みな{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}で{立|た}ちすくんでいた。
examples.english: Everyone who witnessed the accident scene stood frozen, white as a sheet.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}): {顔面|がんめん} (face) + {蒼白|そうはく} (pale, pallid). Describes the dramatic loss of color from the face.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}になる: turn deathly pale
- {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}で{立|た}ちすくむ: stand frozen, pale-faced
- {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}の{患者|かんじゃ}: a pale-faced patient

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {青|あお}ざめる: to turn pale — a verb form; more commonly used in everyday speech
- {血|ち}の{気|け}が{引|ひ}く: the blood drains from one's face — a vivid idiomatic expression for turning pale
- {真|ま}っ{青|さお}になる: to turn completely pale/blue — casual and common

USAGE:
More dramatic and literary than {青|あお}ざめる. Commonly appears in novels, news reports about emergencies, and dramatic descriptions. Can be used as a na-adjective ({顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}な{表情|ひょうじょう}) or as a noun with になる.
